mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate consistently signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (mean return <= 0) in the majority of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending slowdown in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales figure (RSAFS) consistently indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (mean return <= 0) in the majority of periods when RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces household income and consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with reduced liquidity and higher risk aversion, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
